correctness.rationale: Every element has unique 8-parameter coordinates; exact truncated-power identities determine ranks for nonzero linear part. For zero linear part, a 2-by-2 matrix with determinant Δ=d²-ce and u² coefficient Γ=d²+2ce partitions rank cases. Each conic has q² points; their intersection has 2q−1 points outside characteristic 3, and they coincide in characteristic 3. Counting free higher-degree parameters yields disjoint coefficients summing exactly q⁸. Bundled direct matrix-rank verifier exhausts q=2 and q=3 and samples q=4,5,7; it is supporting finite evidence, not an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The exact finite-field multiplicity of each Jordan partition for all 8-parameter nonconstant elements is not supplied by the inspected primary literature, including Example 3.8 of arXiv:1802.07383, which explicitly treats the same ring and already has some support data. The new assertion is finer: exact q-polynomial fiber counts including characteristic 2/3 extension fields, not support novelty. Seven live published-finding corpus semantic searches and targeted source comparisons found no covering enumeration; an unindexed equivalent remains a residual bibliographic risk.

value.rationale: Determines the complete exact Jordan-type frequency distribution of all 8-dimensional maximal-ideal elements in a canonical nine-dimensional Artinian Gorenstein complete intersection. Beyond previously described support, gives q-polynomial rational-point counts and distinguishes the characteristic-3 conic collision from characteristic-2 and ≥5 generic Jordan blocks; these strata form a natural operator-invariant distribution with modular Lefschetz significance.
